structured_output.what_is_happening: "Wojak Accelerationism" (woj/acc) is a pump.fun coin about 15 minutes old. It has already graduated to PumpSwap and is at about $296k market cap, up about 490% in its first hour. Volume is $856k, about 3x market cap, driven by 1,356 unique buyers against 727 unique sellers. Most of that came in the last 5 minutes ($366k-489k), so the rule caught a vertical spike. Price ($0.000296) is already about 27% below the ATH of $0.000408. Structure is clean: mint and freeze authority renounced, LP 100% burned, top 10 holders at 11.7%, dev holding 0.07%, RugCheck score 1, no paid promotion. It has an X handle and a website. The flags are 220 bundler wallets, 778 fresh wallets out of 1,466 holders, and 36 snipers.

narrative.description: A mashup of the Wojak meme and the e/acc 'accelerationism' meme (woj/acc), with the tagline 'born to wojak. forced to accelerate.' It is a culture meme with no news catalyst, but both halves are well-known crypto-Twitter memes, and '/acc' names have run before.
narrative.why_spreading: 1,356 unique buyers in about 15 minutes and a fast graduation point to real retail discovery, probably from pump.fun front-page and graduation feeds plus X. Some of this is bundled or fresh-wallet activity.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the version with all the volume, holders, the X handle (wojaccsolana) and the website. The one earlier copy is dead.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 2RRzQ...pump 'wojacc': created about 75 minutes earlier, now $3.5k market cap with zero liquidity and no volume. Not a threat.

authenticity.evidence: Organic signs: wide spread of buyers (1,356 unique buyers vs 727 unique sellers), a flat top 10 at 11.7%, a tiny dev stake, no paid boosts or ads, a dev funded from KuCoin with no history of serial launches, and 7 smart wallets. Manufactured signs: 220 bundler wallets, about 53% fresh wallets, 36 snipers, and a 14.8% bot/degen rate. Bundlers hold about 10% of the top traders' share.
authenticity.uncertainty: Without X data I can't tell whether a KOL or call channel is behind the spike in the last 5 minutes. The bundled wallets could be the team spreading supply, and they could dump it into the rally.

structural_risks: Entry comes right after a +170% five-minute candle, so a sharp mean-reversion is likely
Price is already about 27% below its ATH, a sign of distribution at the highs
220 bundler wallets and a majority of fresh wallets could dump together
Liquidity of about $50k against a $296k cap means thin depth for large exits

structured_output.counterargument: This could be a classic graduation pump: bundlers and snipers push it through migration, fresh wallets create a fake sense of breadth, and the top is already in at $408k. Buying 4 minutes after a +170% five-minute candle often means eating a -50% retrace within the hour. Nothing in the packet shows a catalyst beyond meme appeal.
unknowns: Who is promoting it on X, and whether KOLs or call channels are involved
Whether the bundler wallets are team-controlled
Where price is at entry compared with the $408k ATH
How much of the volume is wash trading from fresh wallets

structured_output.thesis: A fast, broad-based graduation with clean structure (LP burned, authorities renounced, low concentration, clean dev) and a catchy meme name that is the canonical version. That is better than the typical coin in this pool. A 2x means reaching about $600k, which is plausible if momentum holds. The main risk is timing: buying right after a vertical spike, with bundlers present and price already fading from ATH, gives a real chance of hitting -50% first.
